Minutes August 13 th 2026 Public Hearing and City Council Meeting at City Auditorium Mayor Randy Ausdemore called meeting to order at 6:30 PM. He led the Pledge of Allegiance; he called the Roll. Present were Council Chair Jason Wavrunek, Council Woman Tracy Ogstad, Members Bryce Rossman, Luke Kleinschmit. Mayor called for a motion to open the Public Hearing on the Cities New Comprehensive Plan. Motion by Rossman 2 nd by Wavrun ek. Vote Aye - All. Motion carried. Hearing began at 6:34 PM. There were no comments. Motion by Ogstad 2 nd by Rossman to close Public Hearing. Vote - Aye - All. Motion carried. Hearing ended at 6:37 PM. Motion by Wavrunek 2 nd by Kleinschmit to waive the three re adings of Ordinance 8 - 13 - 26 - 1. Vote - Aye - All . Motion carried.
